items.title: "Thank you for bringing out the hidden gem within each of us."
items.html: — Teresa (Parent of an EduBud student)

items.title: "One of the most meaningful parts of EduBud has been seeing Derren build connections with people who genuinely want to get to know them."
items.html: — Lisa (Parent of an EduBud student)

items.title: "What makes EduBud special is the way everyone gets to know one another. We aren’t just showing up to volunteer hours; we’re building relationships, sharing memories, and becoming part of each other’s lives. It feels like a family where everyone has a place."
items.html: — Rachel (Volunteer from Blue Bridge Project)
